professional_summary: Senior Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience designing and scaling mission-critical web platforms, microservices, and high-concurrency SaaS systems. Expertise across React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and AWS cloud infrastructure. Proven track record resolving queue bottlenecks, cutting API latency, building fault-tolerant event pipelines, and orchestrating zero-downtime releases backed by clean architecture and robust CI/CD. Adept at leading key technical projects and applying AI workflows to accelerate velocity while delivering resilient, production-ready enterprise software.

achievements.description: Architected and built a bulk product import pipeline processing **100K+ products** using BullMQ workers, AWS S3, and validation workflows, achieving an **80% reduction** in manual operations.
Engineered event-driven microservices using Apache Kafka, establishing service boundaries, asynchronous communication patterns, and fault-tolerant workflows across distributed systems.
Built high-performance gRPC internal services for real-time inventory management, seller validation, voucher engine, and logistics integrations.
Delivered a full order lifecycle system with third-party logistics API integration, SLA tracking, automated notifications, and real-time operational dashboards.
Resolved BullMQ and Redis queue bottlenecks, retry failures, and timeout instability under high-load workloads, improving job processing reliability and overall system throughput.
Built seller and admin dashboards using React.js and NestJS to streamline complex operational workflows.
Spearheaded frontend architecture and implementation for a fintech trading platform handling real-time market data, transactional workflows, and compliance-sensitive user operations.
Built WebSocket-driven real-time dashboard updates for high-frequency market activity, optimizing rendering performance through React memoization and structured state management.
Designed scalable frontend state management workflows for authentication, onboarding, trading operations, and real-time portfolio synchronization.

Implemented TOTP-based multi-factor authentication, device fingerprinting, and KYC/AML onboarding workflows using Sumsub OCR verification, reducing unauthorized access incidents and improving verification efficiency.
Built multilingual platform support across **5+ languages** using Next.js and i18next, improving frontend maintainability through reusable component structures and modular dashboard layouts.
Designed and maintained a public-facing GraphQL API platform powering integrations with Zapier, Notion, and Google Docs, handling thousands of developer requests daily.
Achieved a **40% reduction** in third-party integration time through improved API schema design, structured developer documentation, and consistent error contracts.
Implemented OAuth2 authentication, token-based rate limiting, and fault-tolerant error handling for high-concurrency API traffic.
Integrated Airtable as a headless CMS backend, achieving a **20% reduction** in internal content operations workload.
Established system observability using Datadog (metrics, traces, alerting), achieving and sustaining **99.9% API uptime**.
Built a government-backed digital investment platform in React.js, contributing to a **23% increase** in regional investment registrations.
Developed a QR-code-based digital certificate system, achieving a **30% reduction** in manual certificate processing time.
Migrated **30+ legacy Laravel views** to modern React.js components while preserving data integrity and API compatibility.
Collaborated with backend and QA teams to deliver responsive, production-ready features with improved usability and cross-browser compatibility.
